systems.system: Sistema de Tramitação Electrónica de Processos Jurisdicionais (STEPJ)
systems.owner: Centro de Gestão de Tecnologias do Sector da Justiça (CGTSJ), under the Supreme Court
systems.tiers: all courts, Constitutional Council, Public Prosecution

MOZ.note: Law 8/2024 creates the legal regime for the STEPJ and the CGTSJ and tasks the Government with creating the conditions for them to start operating (Art. 48); it states no system procured, piloted, built or in service.
